# Official reference documentation

Public source distributions link to the official documentation; they do not
redistribute complete downloaded website snapshots under Supervisor's license.

- [Codex App Server](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/app-server)
- [Agents API](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents-api/overview)
- [OpenAI developer documentation index](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/llms.txt)
- [Open-source Codex implementation](https://github.com/openai/codex)

The original Supervisor studies remain in `docs/`. Generated protocol contracts
remain in `protocol/app-server/`, with their upstream Apache-2.0 attribution.

For private local reference, `scripts/sync-codex-app-server-docs.ps1` and
`scripts/sync-openai-agents-docs.mjs` download to ignored `target/reference-docs/`.
Historical local copies in this directory are also excluded from publication.
